verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships an official `openclaw` CLI with a documented reference at docs.openclaw.ai/cli. Documented subcommands include `openclaw mcp serve`, `openclaw security audit`, `openclaw fleet` and `openclaw skills` (search/install/update/verify/list/info/check/library/workshop). The install docs also present the CLI as the primary path, with desktop apps as the alternative. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances such as machine-readable or JSON output modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: run OpenClaw as an MCP server with `openclaw mcp serve`
one command tells you if you have drifted: `openclaw security audit`
Use native `openclaw` commands to search, install, and update skills and to install plugins from ClawHub.
